A. If keep gas volume unchanged, temperature rises, pressure decreases
B. keep volume unchanged, temperature lowers, pressure increases
C. keep temperature unchanged, volume smaller, pressure smaller
D. keep temperature unchanged, volume smaller, pressure larger

Ideal gas law PV=nRT. Constant V, P proportional T; temperature rise -> P increase, so A false; temp lower -> P decrease, B false. Constant T, PV constant; volume smaller -> P larger, D true, C false. Answer D.

根据一定质量理想气体状态方程 \(PV=nRT\)：

- 体积不变时，温度升高，压强增大；温度降低，压强减小，所以 A、B 错误。
- 温度不变时，\(PV\) 为常数，体积越小，压强越大，所以 D 正确。

答案：D
